author: gpt-5.6-luna
kind: a release tracking folder: release-blocking issue export (CSV, 50 to 80 issues), cherry-pick queue (CSV), CI signal summary for the release branch (JSON, per job pass rates over 7 days), the release calendar with freeze dates, and the release notes draft
scenario: The release lead is out and the director asks: are we go or no-go for Thursday's release? If no-go, what has to happen and by when.
seeds: (1) a release-blocking issue is closed on main but its fix was never cherry-picked to the release branch; (2) one CI job is flaky at 85% pass rate and another fails consistently since a specific commit; (3) a cherry-pick was approved after the cherry-pick deadline in the calendar; (4) the release notes promise a feature whose ticket was reverted; (5) a decoy: an open issue labelled release-blocker that the triage note demoted.
expertSources: Site Reliability Engineering (book), Release Engineering, https://sre.google/sre-book/release-engineering/ (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, idea only)
